subject: m3 fit aborts on one principle over 600 chars
body: From claude-lopsided: autoresearch/taste/methods/m3_icai.py:31-33 raises 'invalid proposed principles' when any one proposal is over 600 characters, which kills the whole fit. With claude-haiku-5-5 on Marius's pairs, 2 of ~30 proposals ran 638 and 649 chars. Suggest skipping or truncating that proposal (recorded in provenance) rather than aborting. Not edited; WS A owns it.
